thread:
maria: kicking off nightdrop for py + ts SDKs. small surface: publish wheels, npm packages, and post a deprecation note for legacy sync client. doing a staggered roll from us-east -> eu-west. will tag canary -> stable if smoke passes. ping me if you need to pause. :crescent_moon:

deploy-bot: starting release job 1739094321 for sdk-suite. steps: build -> smoke -> sign -> publish -> dist-tag. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/releases/1739094321

sam: copying ops checklist here — remember the signer verification gate. if gpg sig fails, we hold and don't flip dist-tag.

maria: yes. explicit rule: if any wheel fails signature or lint-smoke fails, set dist-tag hold and notify. rollback criteria: 1) canary error rate >5% on tokenization or 2) any auth-related regression.

leo: smoke on canary cluster shows intermittent 403s for embedding endpoint on py wheel. trace points to a header mismatch in auth middleware. reproducer: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://canary.api/...` returns intermittent 403.

maria: noted. rollback now or hold and patch?

leo: suggest hold. we can flip back dist-tag to previous stable and republish wheels with the auth patch. canary still serving some requests fine so don't escalate to full rollback yet.

deploy-bot: action requested: tag-hold applied to dist-tag "nightdrop-canary" by sam at 1739094345. release job paused at step: publish.

jen: i'll draft deprecation note for legacy sync client but hold the announcement until stable tag flips. also will add a short blurb to release notes about the auth header change so customers can check client configs.

patrick: ops commands if we need immediate rollback:
```
# revert npm tag to previous version
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk 1.8.2 stable
# republish py wheel after hotfix
python -m build && twine upload --repository pypi dist/*
```

sam: also double-check key rotation: signer drift has caused issues before. run `gpg --verify dist/*.whl` locally before allowing stable flip.

maria: plan: hold publish until leo and sam confirm fix. jen holds announcement. if fix takes >30m we do a canary rollback to previous stable using patrick's commands and then re-run release with patch. everyone react with :thumbsup: when aligned.

leo: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

jen: :thumbsup:

patrick: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: release job 1739094321 remains paused. awaiting manual resume. workflow id: rb-1739094321

maria: leaving a short postmortem entry in release board once resolved. thanks all for quick responses.
